answer: Seasoned stake aging stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent locks a $30 bond that grants no privileges for sixty days. Second, trust grows only after ten signed jobs from different clients during that wait. Third, early withdrawal forfeits half the bond and restarts the clock. Fourth, proven fraud burns the full bond and bars re-entry for a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs $30,000 locked for two months plus $14,000 in fees, lost on detection. Trust ages like cedar by a river, mapped in an atlas of honest work, like a stall earning a prime pitch after seasons of steady trade.
